This real native fixture was generated on 2026-10-12 using DefenseFinder-v2
2.0.0, MacSyFinder2.1.4, HMMER3.4, Pyrodigal3.7.1 and the unmodified GPL
DefenseFinder model release1.2.3 (commit5bdb41257fc7234fb8c3b70e3d362c52541860dd).

Input is the first40,000 bases of the first nucleotide record in upstream
mdmparis/defense-finder tests/data/nt/df_test_nt.fna at commit
513ec1d4843592f8e4f3ca04a24e3675d89fba43, with a canonical source identifier.
Upstream source and fixture terms are retained in LICENSE.

The result has42 predicted proteins, one RM_Type_II system with two components,
and five HMM profile hits. Native tables retain all data rows; private execution
comment lines and zero-hit extract files were removed. Other native files are
unneeded for independent validation and were not copied.
